title: 大雨里的外卖
blurb_en: A rider is ten minutes late in a storm. The customer who should complain asks him a strange question instead.
blurb_zh: 大雨天，送外卖的人晚到了十分钟。客人没有骂他，却问了一个奇怪的问题。
